rationale: The portfolio already holds an active long position in NU representing 10.0% of buying power. Although NU exhibits strong relative strength against the broader market decline and is consolidating tightly near session highs ($13.25) above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.16), adding to the existing position at the top of an extended intraday range is unnecessary given current exposure and a partially depleted daily loss budget. Shorting is rejected due to the sustained buying volume (3.18x relative volume) and absence of a structural breakdown.
